name: Live & Online Poker Stake-Level Bankroll, 5% Risk-of-Ruin, Rake Cap & Winrate Benchmarks (2026)
description: Quantitative bankroll management, 5% Risk-of-Ruin buy-in buffers, typical rake cap profiles, and hourly/BB-per-100 winrate benchmarks across 7 live and online cash game, PLO, and MTT stake tiers.
category: Bankroll Management, Risk of Ruin & Stake Progression

rows.typical_rake_cap_profile: 10% Up To $5 - $7 Cap + $1 - $2 Promo Drop (High Relative Rake)
rows.move_up_criteria: Log At Least 400 To 500 Verified Live Hours Beating $1/$3 For +8 BB/Hr ($24+/Hr), Accumulate A $10,000 To $15,000 Bankroll, And Take Controlled Friday/Saturday Evening Shots At $2/$5 With A 3-Buy-In ($3,000) Shot Stop-Loss.

rows.typical_rake_cap_profile: 10% Up To $5 - $7 Cap Or Timed Seat Charge ($12 - $14/Hr)
rows.move_up_criteria: Maintain A Verified $55+/Hr Winrate Over 600+ Hours At $2/$5, Build A $45,000 To $60,000 Total Bankroll, And Master 200BB+ Deep-Stack Turn And River Overbet Polarity Before Taking $5/$10 Shots.

rows.typical_rake_cap_profile: Timed Collection ($14 - $18 Per Hour) With $0 Pot Drop
rows.move_up_criteria: At $5/$10+, Progression Shifts From Moving Up Blind Levels To Building Private/Host Network Access, Staking Partnerships, And Maintaining A 40+ Buy-In Liquid Reserve For Straddled $10/$25/$50 Games.

rows.stake_name: Micro Stakes Online NL2 To NL25
rows.five_pct_ror_recommended_bankroll: 25 - 35 Buy-Ins ($50 At NL2 Up To $875 At NL25)
rows.typical_rake_cap_profile: 5% Pot Rake With High BB Caps (8BB - 12BB Cap At Micros)
rows.move_up_criteria: Beat Your Current Micro Level For +6 BB/100 Over 30,000 To 50,000 Tracked Hands And Reach 30 Buy-Ins For The Next Stake Up (With An Automatic Drop-Down At 24 Buy-Ins).

rows.stake_name: Low-To-Mid Stakes Online NL50 To NL200
rows.move_up_criteria: Sustain +4.0 BB/100 Pre-Rakeback Over 75,000+ Hands, Hold 40+ Buy-Ins For The Next Stake, And Maintain Sub-30BB/100 Losses In The Big Blind.

rows.typical_rake_cap_profile: 10% Up To $6 - $7 Cap Or Timed Seat Fee ($12 - $16/Hr)
rows.move_up_criteria: Hold A Minimum Of 40 To 50 Full Buy-Ins Due To 60%-Vs-40% All-In Variance, Log 500+ Live PLO Hours, And Master Blocker-Driven River Pot-Sized Bluffs Before Stepping Into $10/$25 PLO.
Maintain A 100-To-150 Average Buy-In Bankroll, Utilize Smart Selling/Swapping On $1,500+ Main Event Shots, And Master Final Table ICM Deal-Making Calculations.
